mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish on the weather. It is a beautiful clear day reaching 69 degrees near the Verona Public Library with the moon currently in a waxing gibbous phase.

The City of Verona is currently accepting applications for an Engineering Technician to oversee municipal construction projects until September 20. Additionally, residents can now apply for a 30 dollar rebate through the city's rain barrel program by submitting a claim form for their new 35-gallon barrels.

There is plenty to do this weekend, including live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee today, plus a Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness, and starting Monday, we have trivia nights at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee.

In our weekly police report, on Friday, August 15, an officer conducted a traffic stop where the driver was found to be impaired, resulting in an O W I arrest after the operator struggled to stay awake behind the wheel.

Today's Culver's flavor is the decadent Caramel Cashew, and the store is open until 10 PM. For other chilly treats today, Kona Ice will be at Fireman's Park from 11 AM to 5 PM and at the Verona Area High School Stadium for youth football from 1 PM to 7:30 PM.
